main_body: Market stall: striped awning over a produce shelf, on a wooden counter with a two-panel front
top_band: Counter top: rows 26-29, a lighter brown band (#b77541 edge row 26, then #885a26 rows 27-29, L~98-131) above a darker front face (L~49-65). The counter top is partly covered by produce.
evidence: The counter has a visible horizontal top about 4 rows tall, with produce standing on it. A lighter edge row and pink highlights mark the front edge. Below it sit a darker front face of 11 rows and a central panel groove. The step from the top band to the face is about 35-49 L, which meets the 25 L threshold. The awning reads as a sloped roof seen from the front, built the same way as the reference stall roofs. The stall matches the Beodeul stall references in structure, and no receding side face is drawn.

style.evidence: The candidate has 20 colours per tile against 17 and 20 for the references, 37 distinct colours against 38 and 40, and flat-fill coverage of 13%, equal to the cheese stall. Only 1% of dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outlines are tinted dark brown or green. The awning stripes have several green steps, the wood has grain and highlights, and the produce is detailed. A careful artist would accept it next to the references.
